editorial.blurb: A warm, authentic Mediterranean spot where shawarma is legendary and every dish—from flavorful rice to tender kababs—tastes like home.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the shawarma with the Greek salad and don't skip the lentil soup; reviewers keep coming back for this exact combination and rave about the freshness.
